semiconductor_relevance: High — Bronkhorst Korea specializes in high-precision flow control solutions essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Bronkhorst Korea provides high-precision flow control solutions tailored for semiconductor manufacturing, including vibration-free Coriolis mass flow instruments and high-performance vaporizers. Their technology enhances process reliability and production yield by ensuring accurate precursor and chemical delivery for various applications.
capabilities: Coriolis mass flow instruments for chemical delivery
High-performance vaporizers for CVD and diffusion processes
Real Gas Calibration service for accurate gas property reflection

regional_presence.Korea: Bronkhorst Korea operates as a subsidiary of Bronkhorst High-Tech, focusing on the semiconductor market in Korea.
